<!-- Write for someone who has not followed earlier PRs. Explain new terms where used.
Keep the description short. Remove unused prompts. See docs/style.md. -->

Explain the user's problem and what this change lets them do.

Give one concrete example. Introduce its concepts before showing code or commands.
Say what happened before and what happens after this change.

**Limits:** Explain what still leaves the user's question unanswered.
For measurements, name the comparison and included costs before giving a percentage.

**Validation:** State which checks ran and what they established. Link to detailed results.
Keep internal identifiers, complete test inventories and experiment history in those reports.
